description: Reviews a proposed AI workflow for human review needs, data boundaries, quality controls, escalation triggers, unsafe automation risks, and confidence.

aiIdea.description: Specific AI or automation idea the user is considering.

canAffectBrandTrust.description: Whether the workflow can affect brand reputation, customer expectations, or public trust.

canAffectMoney.description: Whether the workflow can influence pricing, refunds, payments, scope, or financial decisions.

currentControls.description: Existing review, approval, QA, escalation, or monitoring controls.

currentProblem.description: Main business or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: Current workflow before AI or automation.

customerFacing.description: Whether the workflow directly affects customers or customer-facing messages.

proposedWorkflow.description: Proposed workflow design, including what AI would do and what humans would review.

requiresExpertJudgment.description: Whether the workflow needs professional, strategic, legal, financial, HR, or domain judgment.

riskConcerns.description: Known concerns about customer trust, brand risk, compliance, money, privacy, or quality control.

usesSensitiveData.description: Whether the workflow may use private, regulated, or sensitive business/customer data.

workflowIdea.description: AI workflow or agent idea to assess for trust and control risk.

name: assess_trust_control_risks

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

dataBoundaryWarnings.description: Warnings about sensitive data, privacy, access boundaries, or inappropriate inputs.

escalationTriggers.description: Conditions that should escalate to a human owner or expert reviewer.

humanReviewRules.description: Rules for when a human must review, approve, or override AI output.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve risk assessment confidence.

notRecommendedActions.description: Actions that should not be automated in the current version.

requiredControls.description: Controls needed before the workflow should be piloted or expanded.

riskLevel.description: Estimated risk level for the workflow or recommendation.

riskSummary.description: Concise public-safe summary of the main trust and control risks.

title: Assess Trust And Control Risks
